title: Chainguard SDK AWS token verification permits cross-service replay
summary: VerifyToken accepts audience and identity binding headers without requiring them in AWS SigV4 SignedHeaders. An attacker can rewrite them on a captured signed GetCallerIdentity request.

severity.rationale: Replay can impersonate a workload at an attacker-selected audience. This directly affects identity federation used in developer supply chains.

exposure: A relying party must use auth/aws.VerifyToken. The attacker needs a valid victim-signed request within its validity window.

params.instructions: Check chainguard.dev/sdk version and whether the documented exposure conditions apply.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed component uses the patched release and test the affected workflow with harmless inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
